diagnosis: All 8 invoices that reached the form failed at the Date field; none got as far as Save. Supplier entry worked 8 out of 8 times: click the lower 'Supplier' at y≈213, type, press Return, and Account becomes 'Creditors' (S4, S11, S25, S29, S34).

The first click on the date line ('Sep 19, 2026 ...') turns it into a native date-time input reading '19/09/2026, 15:39:09' and opens a calendar popup ('September 2026', 'Clear', 'Today'; S6, S13, S27). With the popup open, type_date did nothing: step 6 shows screen_changed=False in every one of the 8 invoices. The popup appears to swallow the keystrokes.
The date format was also wrong. The playbook typed MM/DD/YYYY, but the field is day-first (DD/MM/YYYY): today shows as '19/09/2026'.

A second click on the date line closes the popup but puts the cursor in the YEAR segment, because the click lands at the centre of the line. Typing then corrupts the year: invoice 13, step 8 produced '19/09/72620, 23:40:05' (S15), and later a red 'Date is required' (S16).
Jev then looped on the date line. Steps 8 to 11 of invoices 14, 15, 16, 17, 18 and 20 were the same click with screen_changed=False, and the run was aborted. That is 5 wasted steps per invoice.

Invoice 13, step 12: after type_item the dropdown was still open and the item cell still focused. Jev chose type_amount (conf 0.25), so '10.00' landed in the item cell ('Al Models & API10.', S20/S21). The Rate cell (the '$0.00' at x≈1079 in the row) was never clicked.
The Anthropic amount was read wrong twice (invoices 14 and 18). The picked line '$200.00 USD due July 30, 2026' contains a date, and the year 2026 was parsed as the amount (2026.0 instead of 200.00).
Invoices 11 and 19 (WellyBox, ILS) passed with 0 steps, so the currency hints work and are kept.
